description: This file defines the SelectedCalendarsRepository class, which manages CRUD operations for selected calendar entities using Prisma ORM services. It includes methods for upserting, retrieving, adding, and removing user-selected calendars, with specific handling for nullable eventTypeId and delegation credentials.

classes.name: SelectedCalendarsRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing selected calendar data, providing methods for CRUD operations with specific logic for user-level calendars.

methods.name: upsertSelectedCalendar
methods.description: Creates or updates a selected calendar record for a user, based on existence.

methods.name: getUserSelectedCalendars
methods.description: Retrieves all calendars selected by a user.

methods.name: getUserSelectedCalendar
methods.description: Retrieves a specific selected calendar for a user based on external ID and integration.

methods.name: getUserEventTypeSelectedCalendar
methods.description: Retrieves calendars with non-null eventTypeId for a user.

methods.name: addUserSelectedCalendar
methods.description: Adds a new selected calendar for a user if it does not already exist.

methods.name: removeUserSelectedCalendar
methods.description: Removes a specific selected calendar for a user, with error handling for multiple or no records found.
